=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:896-908 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified`, `(if ($blocks | length) > 1 then $blocks[-2] else "" end) as $floor` sets `$floor` to `""` when only one trusted "Planning blocked" comment exists, so `(.created_at // "") > $floor` accepts any older trusted `<!-- ai:implement-success-noop:v1 issue=<item> -->` marker. That includes the marker posted by `.github/workflows/implement.yml:5798` (Guard 0). The stale marker then counts as proof that the newest block's verify passed.
  WHY: An issue that Guard 0 closed, then reopened and re-planned, gets a nothing-to-implement block whose verify failed (pnti_note_failed, plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh lines 107-109 / :180). `unblock_main` then calls `unblock_nothing_to_implement_close "" "" "${tracking}"` and closes the issue as completed with `ai:closed`. The close comment (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:959) falsely says "the plan run's verify passed the listed tests on the planning ref", which contradicts the changelog.d/10062 contract "only when it belongs to the newest 'Planning blocked' comment". Proposed fix: require the newest trusted block body to contain "passed on the planning ref, but the issue could not be closed automatically" (plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh:184), or require `(.created_at // "") > $blocks[-1]`. The fixture `_verified_noop_comments` (tests/test_unblock_judge.py:6051) uses note text the script never emits. The `stale_marker` test covers only the two-block case. All reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high); there is no disagreement.
- README.md:473 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run edited the README.md `GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED` table row and the `IMPLEMENT_GITHUB_AI_GRANT` registry bullet in agents.d/9920-github-ai-plan-grant-write.md to document `outcome=refused reason=add_failed`. Both files are outside this PR's Phase 8b mandate and file allowlist.
  WHY: The content matches scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:541 (lines 536-542). However, the plan file list (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:465-469) and the issue's `files_touched` grant do not cover README.md. The README change also modifies an existing row in place, which breaks the append-only rule. This is a scope and compliance issue only, with no runtime failure (rated NIT, mapped to low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 judged the same edits accurate and found no contract drift.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md Phase 8b (:202, :332): "existing blocks close on the judge's next run without a fix-up" / "allow the close without a finished fix-up when a trusted `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` or `PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT ... outcome=closed`-equivalent marker exists, under the same switch. This clears blocks that existed before 8a merged."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified / unblock_nothing_to_implement_close (verified mode)
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Verified mode accepts only an `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` marker posted after the second-newest block. Pre-8a blocks with no marker go through the judge's `reset` route instead, as agents.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md says ("still clear through the judge's reset verdict"). The `PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT ... outcome=closed`-equivalent marker form is not implemented anywhere in scripts/unblock_judge.sh:896-908. The narrowing is deliberate but deferred by neither the plan nor the issue. Any widening must keep the newest-block binding so the stale-marker defect does not get worse (both reviewers rated this NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified (about lines 897-908) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The only time bound is the second-newest trusted "Planning blocked" comment. With one trusted block, $floor is "", so any earlier "<!-- ai:implement-success-noop:v1 issue=<item> -->" marker counts as proof, including the one from .github/workflows/implement.yml Guard 0 (line 5798).
  WHY: Take an issue that Guard 0 closed, then reopened and re-planned. Its verify fails (pnti_note_failed, lines 107-109) and posts no marker. The old marker still matches, so `unblock_nothing_to_implement_close "" "" ""` closes it as completed with a false "verify passed" comment, breaking the changelog promise. Proposed fix: require the newest block body to contain the pnti_note_failed_pass text (plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh line 184, written via plan.yml lines 2679-2681), and add an "older marker, single block whose verify failed" case to test_verified_noop_close_keeps_today_otherwise. The `_verified_noop_comments` fixture note "Verify: 1 listed test(s) passed but the issue could not be closed." is never emitted by the script.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: Plan docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md, Phase 8b: allow the close without a finished fix-up when a trusted ai:implement-success-noop:v1 (or closed-equivalent) marker exists, under the same switch. "This clears blocks that existed before 8a merged" / "existing blocks close on the judge's next run without a fix-up."
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified / the verified mode of unblock_nothing_to_implement_close
  Evidence of absence: Verified mode accepts only a marker posted after the second-newest block. The agents.d/10062 fragment says pre-8a blocks still clear through the reset verdict. The narrowing is deliberate but not deferred, and any widening must not make the stale-marker defect worse.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- HARDENING (scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified jq filter): the marker is not tied to the newest block's verify result. Fix: also require the newest trusted block body to contain "passed on the planning ref, but the issue could not be closed automatically", update the fixture, and add a single-failed-block plus older-Guard-0-marker case. Estimated 4 script lines and about 6 test lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- Info: The README.md and agents.d/9920 edits match scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh line 541, so there is no contract drift; the edits come from the base. The .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml env line is gated with default 'true', and the marker check accepts only comments from UNBLOCK_LOGIN.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:899-907 (in `unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` marker is wrongly accepted when an issue has only one "Planning blocked" comment.
  WHY: `$floor` is `""`, so `(.created_at // "") > $floor` is true for any marker in the issue history, including stale ones, ones from a failed verify, or ones from an unrelated attempt. This wrongly closes issues as completed and breaks the newest-block changelog contract.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified (lines 897-908), `(if ($blocks | length) > 1 then $blocks[-2] else "" end) as $floor` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: With one trusted block, `$floor` is `""`, and the lexicographic comparison `(.created_at // "") > $floor` lets a stale marker (for example implement.yml Guard 0, line 5798, `issue=${ISSUE_NUMBER}`) satisfy the verify-passed check. This happens even after a `/reclarify` re-block whose verify failed or was turned off.
  WHY: The marker survives a reopen. `unblock_main` calls `unblock_nothing_to_implement_close "" "" "${tracking}"`, which closes the issue as completed with a misleading comment and a misleading `outcome=closed reason=verified_noop` log line. This contradicts changelog.d/10062.
- HARDENING (scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified lines 899-907): same root cause. Fix: require the newest block body to contain the `pnti_note_failed_pass` text from scripts/plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh, or require `(.created_at // "") > $blocks[-1]`. About 4 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- Info: The last-run README.md and agents.d/9920-github-ai-plan-grant-write.md edits match scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:541, and the last run introduced no issues. The pre-push gate's baseline_timeout for `tests/test_unblock_judge.py` is informational, not a defect.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  PROBLEM: With exactly one trusted block, `$floor` is `""`, so any older trusted `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` marker counts as a verify pass. `.github/workflows/implement.yml:5798` (Guard 0) has posted that marker since #8191.
  WHY: In this chain, Guard 0 closes the issue, a human reopens it with `/reclarify`, the re-block's verify fails without posting a marker (plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh:180), and the stale marker passes the check. The issue is closed as completed with the false close comment at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:959, which contradicts the changelog.d/10062 and agents.d/10062 contracts. The `stale_marker` test covers only two blocks. Remedy: require the newest block to contain the plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh:184 text. The fixture at tests/test_unblock_judge.py:6051 does not match the emitted text.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: Plan docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:202 — "8b (unblock judge): existing blocks close on the judge's next run without a fix-up." — and :332 — "allow the close without a finished fix-up when a trusted `ai:implement-success-noop:v1` or `PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT ... outcome=closed`-equivalent marker exists, under the same switch. This clears blocks that existed before 8a merged."
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_nothing_to_implement_verified / unblock_nothing_to_implement_close (verified mode).
  Evidence of absence: Pre-8a blocks without a marker go through the `reset` route (agents.d/10062-unblock-nothing-to-implement-verified-close.md). The `PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT ... outcome=closed`-equivalent form is not implemented, and scripts/unblock_judge.sh:896-908 accepts only the noop comment marker. The narrowing is deliberate and not deferred, and any widening must keep the newest-block binding.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- README.md (line 473 row) and agents.d/9920-github-ai-plan-grant-write.md | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The last run documented `reason=add_failed`, which is accurate against scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:541 (lines 536-542). Both files are outside the Phase 8b mandate (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:465-469). README.md is not covered by any grant entry, and the in-place row edit breaks the append-only README rule.
  WHY: There is no runtime failure; this is a scope and compliance issue only. Revert the edits into a separate PR or confirm the grant covers them.
